thread:
nina: Heads-up, I'm proposing we split the onboard bench into 'smoke', 'replay', and 'golden' stages to reduce blocking and clarify ownership. Current single-stage bench is too slow for PRs.

devin: +1. What's the intended cost/latency profile for each stage?

nina: smoke = inline, ~1-2 min, token-level parity on 50 tiny samples. replay = asynchronous bench-fleet, ~15-20 min, ~200 sequences stratified by seq_len and session_type. golden = exhaustive coverage, can take hours, used for final promotion.

alex: Important: replay must emulate real runtime warmup. Add a simulate_prefix flag with enum {none, short, full} so probers can hit the same KV/cache warm path.

yu: Also, we currently have inconsistent retry policies across adapters. Suggestion: smoke allows 1 retry on infra errors; replay and golden use zero retries to surface true failures.

nina: Agreed on retry policy. Another difference: smoke should return a compact triage blob (3 failing examples + token diffs) while replay/golden produce full artifacts. That keeps PR noise low.

devin: For promotion gating, propose: stable promotion requires at least one successful golden run within 72h; canary tag requires successful replay within 24h. Teams can opt into experimental policy at registration.

ci-bot: note: schema change pending - adding simulate_prefix and promotion_policy fields to model registration.

alex: We also need a lightweight local CLI to run smoke/replay with a smaller sample set for SEs: `rwi prober run --lane replay --samples 30 --simulate_prefix short`.

yu: Sampling strategy: keep a small, high-value stratum for tokenization/code edge cases (5% of samples), and weight medium seq_len heavier to catch KV off-by-one issues.

nina: Metrics to expose: pass_rate, p95_latency, session_stability (fraction of sessions with no token divergence). Use thresholds: smoke >= 99.5% pass, replay >= 99.9%, golden >= 99.995%.

devin: One operational note: artifact TTLs. Golden artifacts can be big; default TTL 30 days. Smoke/replay artifacts TTL 7 days. Bench team will curate golden sets; model owners can request additions.

alex: One more: add golden_set_id in handshake metadata so prober knows which baseline to compare against.

bench-bot: scheduled: replay rwi-test-model (200 seq) on bench-fleet. ETA 12m, artifact path: /bench/artifacts/1769998905.

yu: Cool. I'll draft the RFC with: new prober lanes, handshake schema, retry rules, promotion policy, metrics. Nina, can you open the RFC and tag bench/orch owners?

nina: Will do this afternoon. Thanks everyone.
